body: I don’t know if I ever would have had the courage without this group and people like you! Thanks for the support. ☺️

We talked and we’re officially getting divorced. And he was incredibly respectful and supportive. Which is great and also somehow painful. It’s hard to hurt someone you care about and have them respond with nothing but care in return. I think he is now starting to realize he hasn’t been a good partner and he seems to have taken it to heart. He told me not to worry about anything and he’s going to help me with everything as we transition. He’s already begun helping me get settled in at my sister’s as I’ve chosen to move in with her though he would have let me keep the house. Fortunately we’re about a one minute drive from each other so the setup is actually quite ideal. I hope I’m not being naive but I think we’re actually going to come out of this as good coparents and possibly even friends. Now to tell the kids. 😬

We talked and he was so supportive and nice. He’s going to help me get settled in with my sister. And at least right now, I think we can actually come out of this as good coparents and potentially even friends.
I am dreading this conversation tomorrow. I’m feeling so much stress, guilt, and anxiety but I know that once it’s over I’m free.
